reviewScope: Independent read-only bounded review of the frozen B-only incremental source export/import helper and sealed input.

facts.oldSnapshotAndArtifacts: Required read-only dependencies hashed by the helper; not copied.
facts.newObjectMembership: Exact TIP excluding prior3c79 object inventory checked in the fresh owned bare store with alternates unset before prerequisite-assisted connectivity.
facts.connectivity: Narrow exact-tip check using read-only prior imported and inherited baseline object pools.
facts.resultSchema: Export and import retain current source binding plus sourceBundle/sourceGraph/sourceDeltaManifest descriptors and actual hashed generated input.
facts.failureHandling: Fresh owned UUID attempts, raw command output and FAIL receipt preserved; pass emitted only after guards settle.
facts.sourceAndOriginalGitGuards: Exact clean current branch/head and raw source/checkpoint chain before and after; original refs/config/commit-graph and prior imported pool metadata unchanged.

limitations.prerequisiteRuntimeAndRawSourceClosure: Reviewed helper guards; actual execution is a separate root action.
limitations.receiptSupplements: Metadata only; final evidence assembly owns complete raw command and snapshot closure.
